name: devops-command-center
description: A unified command center for DevOps operations.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,green "npm run dev -w @devops-command-center/web" "npm run dev -w @devops-command-center/api"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @devops-command-center/shared && npm run typecheck -w @devops-command-center/api && npm run typecheck -w @devops-command-center/web
scripts.build: npm run build -w @devops-command-center/shared && npm run build -w @devops-command-center/api && npm run build -w @devops-command-center/web
